22: cardinality of the elements that are not equal.

24: We give instances of this construction for emetric spaces, metric spaces, normed groups and normed

12: /-! # The `WithLp` type synonym
13: 
14: `WithLp p V` is a copy of `V` with exactly the same vector space structure, but with the Lp norm
15: instead of any existing norm on `V`; recall that by default `ι → R` and `R × R` are equipped with
16: a norm defined as the supremum of the norms of their components.
17: 
18: This file defines the vector space structure for all types `V`; the norm structure is built for
19: different specializations of `V` in downstream files.
20: 
21: Note that this should not be used for infinite products, as in these cases the "right" Lp spaces is
22: not the same as the direct product of the spaces. See the docstring in `Mathlib/Analysis/PiLp` for
23: more details.
24: 
25: ## Main definitions
26: 
27: * `WithLp p V`: a copy of `V` to be equipped with an L`p` norm.
28: * `WithLp.toLp`: the canonical inclusion from `V` to `WithLp p V`.
29: * `WithLp.ofLp`: the canonical inclusion from `WithLp p V` to `V`.
30: * `WithLp.linearEquiv p K V`: the canonical `K`-module isomorphism between `WithLp p V` and `V`.
31: 
32: ## Implementation notes
33: 
34: The pattern here is the same one as is used by `Lex` for order structures; it avoids having a
35: separate synonym for each type (`ProdLp`, `PiLp`, etc), and allows all the structure-copying code
36: to be shared.
37: 
38: TODO: is it safe to copy across the topology and uniform space structure too for all reasonable
39: choices of `V`?
40: -/
41: 
42: @[expose] public section
43: 
44: 
45: open scoped ENNReal
46: 
47: /-- A type synonym for the given `V`, associated with the L`p` norm. Note that by default this just
48: forgets the norm structure on `V`; it is up to downstream users to implement the L`p` norm (for
49: instance, on `Prod` and finite `Pi` types). -/
50: structure WithLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) (V : Type*) where
51:   /-- Converts an element of `V` to an element of `WithLp p V`. -/
52:   toLp (p) ::
53:   /-- Converts an element of `WithLp p V` to an element of `V`. -/
54:   ofLp : V
55: 
56: section Notation
57: 
58: open Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator
59: 
60: /-- This prevents `toLp p x` being printed as `{ ofLp := x }` by `delabStructureInstance`. -/
61: @[app_delab WithLp.toLp]
62: meta def WithLp.delabToLp : Delab := delabApp
63: 
64: end Notation
65: 
66: variable (p : ℝ≥0∞) (K K' : Type*) {K'' : Type*} (V : Type*) {V' V'' : Type*}
67: 
68: namespace WithLp
69: 
70: /-- `WithLp.ofLp` and `WithLp.toLp` as an equivalence. -/
71: @[simps]
72: protected def equiv : WithLp p V ≃ V where
73:   toFun := ofLp
74:   invFun := toLp p
75:   left_inv _ := rfl
76:   right_inv _ := rfl
77: 
78: @[simp]
79: lemma equiv_symm_apply : ⇑(WithLp.equiv p V).symm = toLp p := rfl
80: 
81: /-! `WithLp p V` inherits various module-adjacent structures from `V`. -/
82: 
83: instance instNontrivial [Nontrivial V] : Nontrivial (WithLp p V) := (WithLp.equiv p V).nontrivial
84: instance instUnique [Unique V] : Unique (WithLp p V) := (WithLp.equiv p V).unique
85: instance instDecidableEq [DecidableEq V] : DecidableEq (WithLp p V) :=
86:   (WithLp.equiv p V).decidableEq
87: 
88: instance instAddCommGroup [AddCommGroup V] : AddCommGroup (WithLp p V) :=
89:   (WithLp.equiv p V).addCommGroup
90: @[to_additive] instance instSMul [SMul K V] : SMul K (WithLp p V) :=
91:   (WithLp.equiv p V).smul K
92: @[to_additive] instance instMulAction [Monoid K] [MulAction K V] : MulAction K (WithLp p V) :=
93:   fast_instance% (WithLp.equiv p V).mulAction K
94: instance instDistribMulAction [Monoid K] [AddCommGroup V] [DistribMulAction K V] :
95:     DistribMulAction K (WithLp p V) := fast_instance% (WithLp.equiv p V).distribMulAction K
96: instance instModule [Semiring K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] : Module K (WithLp p V) :=
97:   fast_instance% (WithLp.equiv p V).module K
98: 
99: variable {K V}
100: 
101: lemma ofLp_toLp (x : V) : ofLp (toLp p x) = x := rfl
102: @[simp] lemma toLp_ofLp (x : WithLp p V) : toLp p (ofLp x) = x := rfl
103: 
104: lemma ext_iff {x y : WithLp p V} : x = y ↔ x.ofLp = y.ofLp :=
105:   (WithLp.equiv p V).injective.eq_iff.symm
106: 
107: lemma ofLp_surjective : Function.Surjective (@ofLp p V) :=
108:   Function.RightInverse.surjective <| ofLp_toLp _
109: 
110: lemma toLp_surjective : Function.Surjective (@toLp p V) :=
111:   Function.RightInverse.surjective <| toLp_ofLp _
112: 
113: lemma ofLp_injective : Function.Injective (@ofLp p V) :=
114:   Function.LeftInverse.injective <| toLp_ofLp _
115: 
116: lemma toLp_injective : Function.Injective (@toLp p V) :=
117:   Function.LeftInverse.injective <| ofLp_toLp _
118: 
119: lemma ofLp_bijective : Function.Bijective (@ofLp p V) :=
120:   ⟨ofLp_injective p, ofLp_surjective p⟩
121: 
122: lemma toLp_bijective : Function.Bijective (@toLp p V) :=
123:   ⟨toLp_injective p, toLp_surjective p⟩
124: 
125: /-- Lift a function to `WithLp`. -/
126: @[simp]
127: protected def map (f : V → V') (x : WithLp p V) : WithLp p V' :=
128:   toLp p (f x.ofLp)
129: 
130: @[simp]
131: theorem map_id : WithLp.map p (id (α := V)) = id :=
132:   rfl
133: 
134: theorem map_comp (f : V' → V'') (g : V → V') :
135:     WithLp.map p (f ∘ g) = WithLp.map p f ∘ WithLp.map p g :=
136:   rfl
137: 
138: /-- Lift an equivalence to `WithLp`. -/
139: protected def congr (f : V ≃ V') : WithLp p V ≃ WithLp p V' :=
140:   (WithLp.equiv p V).trans <| f.trans <| (WithLp.equiv p V').symm
141: 
142: @[simp]
143: theorem coe_congr (f : V ≃ V') : ⇑(WithLp.congr p f) = WithLp.map p f :=
144:   rfl
145: 
146: @[simp]
147: theorem congr_refl : WithLp.congr p (Equiv.refl V) = Equiv.refl _ :=
148:   rfl
